goal: Deep research affiliate readiness for priority and secondary offers before any SCALE decision.
context: Priority: Make.com, Hostinger, ElevenLabs. Secondary: NordVPN, Grammarly, ClickUp. Use current official sources; mark unknowns needs_verification. No real secrets, applications, posting, or spend.
requirements: Verify current affiliate terms and program-open status from official sources
Verify explicit Vietnam eligibility or record needs_verification
Document application and approval difficulty with evidence
Document payout method, threshold, validation delay, schedule, tax/KYC needs, and Vietnam practicality
Verify cookie or attribution model and last-click rules
Capture prohibited promotional methods, trademark bidding rules, coupon rules, and disclosure requirements
Define 2-3 buyer personas and buyer-intent keyword clusters per offer
Produce exactly 5 short-form content angles per offer with hook, promise, proof/demo, CTA, and compliance note
acceptance_criteria: All six offers have dated official-source URLs for every commercial claim
Unknown or portal-only facts are marked needs_verification, never inferred as fact
Readiness breakdown uses Program open 30, Vietnam eligible 20, Approval difficulty 15, Payout practicality 15, Commercial terms verified 20
No offer with readiness below 60 is recommended for SCALE
Priority offers appear first: Make.com, Hostinger, ElevenLabs
Secondary offers follow: NordVPN, Grammarly, ClickUp
Each offer has personas, buyer-intent keywords, and five short-form angles
